newsitem.title: ITALY: Aeroporti di Roma offer oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Aeroporti di Roma offer oversubscribed.

text.p: A public sale offer of Italian airport operator Aeroporti di Roma (ADR), which closed on Wednesday, was heavily oversubscribed, the company said.
It said in a statement 185,000 bidders applied for around 170 million shares while the institutional offer was 21 times oversubscribed.
A green shoe option, to lift the stake to be placed on the market to 45 percent from 41 percent, was likely to be exercised.
ADR said the offer, in which shares were priced at 11,000 lire, was 28 times oversubscribed among foreign institutional investors and 12 times among Italian institutional investors.
"Shares were sought by the main international investment funds, which had shown their interest during the roadshow," it said.

Italian industrial holding Iri's stake in ADR would fall to around 54 percent with the exercise of the green shoe. The company has said it expects to make its stock market debut on July 24 or 25. - Rome Newsroom +396 678 2501
